# dagsterplus_alert_policies (Data Source)

Lists all Dagster+ alert policies in a deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_alert_policies" "prod" {
  deployment = "prod"
}

output "policy_names" {
  value = [for p in data.dagsterplus_alert_policies.prod.alert_policies : p.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment` (String) The name of the deployment to list alert policies for.

### Read-Only

- `alert_policies` (Attributes List) All alert policies in the deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_policies))
- `id` (String) Static identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--alert_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_policies`

Read-Only:

- `asset` (Attributes List) Asset-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = asset). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_policies--asset))
- `automation` (Attributes List) Automation-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = automation). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_policies--automation))
- `budget` (Attributes List) Budget-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = budget). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_policies--budget))
- `code_location` (Attributes List) Code location-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = code_location). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_policies--code_location))
- `deployment` (String) The deployment this alert policy belongs to.
- `description` (String) A human-readable description of the alert policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alert policy is active.
- `event_types` (List of String) Event types that trigger the alert.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier in the form `{deployment}/{name}`.
- `insight_metric` (Attributes List) Insight metric-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = insight_metric). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_policies--insight_metric))
- `name` (String) The alert policy name.
- `notification_service` (Attributes) The notification channel configured for this alert policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_policies--notification_service))
- `policy_type` (String) The category of alert policy: asset, run, code_location, automation, budget, or insight_metric.
- `run` (Attributes List) Run-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = run). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_policies--run))

<a id="nestedatt--alert_policies--asset"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_policies.asset`

Read-Only:

- `all_assets` (Boolean) True when the policy applies to all assets.
- `asset_key` (String) Specific asset key path.
- `asset_selection` (String) Asset selection string (e.g. 'tag:my-tag').
- `health_status` (String) Health status transition: degraded, warning, or healthy.
- `specific_events` (List of String) Specific asset events that trigger the alert.


<a id="nestedatt--alert_policies--automation"></a>

Read-Only:

- `include_schedules` (Boolean) Whether schedules are included.
- `include_sensors` (Boolean) Whether sensors are included.
- `min_consecutive_failures` (Number) Minimum consecutive failures before alerting.
- `schedules_and_sensors` (List of String) Specific schedule or sensor names.

Read-Only:

- `operator` (String) Comparison operator: greater_than or less_than.

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--alert_policies--run"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_policies.run`

Read-Only:

- `job_names` (List of String) Job names filter.
- `on_failure` (Boolean) Alert on run failure.

- `on_timeout_hours` (Number) Alert when a run exceeds this many hours.
- `tags` (String) Run filter tag in 'key=value' format.
